nodes.name: Gouf 01
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: At dusk, Gouf volunteers to hang every courtyard fairy light.{pause}Forty bulbs wait in a box labeled WARM WHITE, GENTLE MOOD.{pause}The courtyard committee provides clips, extension cords, and no ladder.{pause}Gouf uncoils his long cable with unmistakable professional pride.{pause}A neighbor moves the fern three feet away for emotional safety.{pause}The block party begins in one hour, whether the lights cooperate or not.{pause}Somebody starts the snack table early, creating immediate tactical pressure.

nodes.name: Gouf 02
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: One cable, forty bulbs, no ladders. This is my specialty.{pause}He ties the light string to his cable and tests one careful swing.{pause}The bulbs rise beautifully, circle once, and land in the snack bowl.{pause}Nobody is hurt, though three crackers become briefly illuminated.{pause}The neighbor removes the bowl and writes NO FOOD in the flight zone.{pause}Gouf calls the first attempt useful calibration instead of failure.{pause}The illuminated crackers are retired from service with full honors.

nodes.name: Gouf 03
nodes.speaker: Neighbor
nodes.dialogue: The cable caught two chairs and one extremely patient fern.{pause}Gouf releases the chairs in the order they became involved.{pause}The fern keeps one bulb looped around a leaf like a necklace.{pause}Its owner says the look is charming but probably not fire code.{pause}Gouf apologizes to the plant with surprising formality.{pause}Then he draws a safer swing radius in chalk around his boots.{pause}The fern remains inside the circle, possibly as an official observer.

nodes.name: Gouf 04
nodes.speaker: Committee
nodes.dialogue: Lights must reach four corners, the gate, and the little stage.{pause}Keep the center clear for dancing and the west wall clear for food.{pause}The old outlet supports one string, not a heroic electrical event.{pause}Every bulb must stay above helmet height and below the tree branches.{pause}Gouf repeats the requirements while measuring with his cable.{pause}The cable measures everything in units called approximately enough.{pause}The committee translates that measurement into six nervous pencil marks.

nodes.name: Gouf 05
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Neighbors bring folding chairs, paper lanterns, and potted herbs.{pause}Each new object enters the chalk circle despite the NO OBJECTS note.{pause}Gouf moves the circle. The neighbors move the chairs into the new one.{pause}Soon the courtyard resembles a furniture puzzle with refreshments.{pause}The fern returns on a rolling stand, still wearing its single bulb.{pause}Gouf begins suspecting the plant has joined the lighting committee.{pause}Its leaves point toward the stage with suspicious organizational confidence.

nodes.name: Gouf 06
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Tension check. Clip check. Bulb check. Chair migration check.{pause}He practices threading the cable through a row of empty clothespins.{pause}The first pass misses. The second collects six pins and a napkin.{pause}The third lands correctly and receives polite committee applause.{pause}Gouf pretends applause is standard for all responsible cable handling.{pause}The neighbor quietly adds RESPONSIBLE to his volunteer badge.{pause}He angles the badge toward every future round of applause.

nodes.name: Gouf 07
nodes.speaker: Neighbor
nodes.dialogue: My mother used to hang lights here with a broom and string.{pause}They were never straight, but everyone knew the party had begun.{pause}Gouf looks up at the bare courtyard and lowers his practice cable.{pause}He admits he likes equipment that does exactly what he commands.{pause}The neighbor says decorations work best when they invite people, not obey.{pause}Gouf decides the final pattern should feel welcoming before impressive.{pause}The fern rustles once, apparently voting for welcome and its own spotlight.{pause}She shows him an old photograph where half the bulbs are dark and every neighbor is smiling{pause}beneath them anyway.{pause}The crooked strands form no tactical pattern, but each sag marks a doorway where somebody brought{pause}another chair outside.{pause}Gouf notices one child in the photograph holding a wooden spool like a trophy and asks who planned{pause}the arrangement.{pause}Nobody did, the neighbor says; everyone solved the next reachable piece and made room for the next{pause}pair of hands.

nodes.name: Gouf 08
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: They pause while sunset turns every window copper and blue.{pause}The title melody returns with the soft click of forty tested bulbs.{pause}Gouf holds the cable still instead of searching for the next target.{pause}The fern's single light glows first, small and completely unnecessary.{pause}Neighbors set cups on tables and speak in easy half-finished sentences.{pause}For a minute, the unfinished courtyard already feels like a party.{pause}A child declares the lone bulb the opening act and bows.

nodes.name: Gouf 09
nodes.speaker: SYSTEM
nodes.dialogue: Wind forecast updated: mild gusts after dark.{pause}The center tree offers a strong high anchor, if reached carefully.{pause}Perimeter hooks offer many low anchors and much more walking.{pause}Starting from the center makes every span share one point.{pause}Starting from the corners keeps failures small and separate.{pause}Gouf weighs one elegant throw against twenty-four sensible clips.

nodes.name: Gouf 10
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: A center anchor will make the installation fast and dramatic.{pause}Corner anchors will make every line predictable and easy to repair.{pause}The cable is perfect for one distant placement above the stage.{pause}The clips are perfect for staying exactly where they are placed.{pause}The committee trusts Gouf to choose how the work begins.{pause}He studies the fern, the tree, and the migrating chairs one last time.

nodes.name: Gouf A1
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Center anchor selected. Clear the circle and respect the chalk.{pause}He loops the light string behind his cable and aims above the stage.{pause}One smooth cast arcs through the dusk and catches the tree branch.{pause}The bulbs settle in a bright line without touching food or fern.{pause}Gouf holds the pose until applause confirms somebody saw it.{pause}The courtyard gains a glowing spine from which every route can grow.

nodes.name: Gouf A2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The central line is beautiful and also pulling one table sideways.{pause}A forgotten tablecloth corner has wrapped around the cable end.{pause}Gouf lowers tension while neighbors unload cups in a fast relay.{pause}The table rolls two inches, stops, and keeps all four legs dignified.{pause}The fern watches from outside the circle with its bulb blinking.{pause}Gouf adds TABLECLOTH CHECK to his growing list of procedures.

nodes.name: Gouf A3
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Now every remaining strand can descend from the center.{pause}He sends short lines toward the gate, food wall, and stage corners.{pause}Neighbors catch each end with clips before the cable swings again.{pause}The system turns a solo trick into a careful group rhythm.{pause}Cast, catch, clip, test. Even the children whisper the pattern.{pause}The original dramatic anchor becomes useful because everyone holds it.

nodes.name: Gouf A4
nodes.speaker: Committee
nodes.dialogue: Center installation complete. One branch, eight spans, zero spills.{pause}The wind moves all lines together like a slow glowing breath.{pause}Gouf checks the branch twice and adds a backup cord without being asked.{pause}The neighbor awards the fern's spare clip to the central knot.{pause}Spectacle now has redundancy, a word Gouf enjoys saying aloud.{pause}They step back with thirty minutes left for the final pattern.

nodes.name: Gouf B1
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Perimeter first. Straight lines, gentle corners, dependable clips.{pause}He walks the courtyard edge and marks every anchor at equal height.{pause}The neighbor follows with the box while the fern rides behind them.{pause}Each hook receives one clip, one tug, and one spoken confirmation.{pause}The process is slow enough for everyone to offer advice.{pause}Gouf accepts the useful advice and files the rest under atmosphere.

nodes.name: Gouf B2
nodes.speaker: Neighbor
nodes.dialogue: Corner three has brick too hard for the borrowed hook.{pause}Gouf considers drilling, then notices a sturdy rain-pipe bracket.{pause}The committee checks permission with the building manager first.{pause}Permission arrives with a warning not to decorate the drain itself.{pause}Gouf clips beside the bracket and leaves the pipe completely ordinary.{pause}The dependable plan survives its first temptation to become exciting.

nodes.name: Gouf B3
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The perimeter line advances one careful wall section at a time.{pause}Chairs can move freely because no strand crosses the center.{pause}The snack table expands without entering any dangerous arc.{pause}The fern receives a proper low hook and surrenders its borrowed bulb.{pause}Gouf almost misses the tiny glow, then clips it beside the gate.{pause}The simple border begins making every ordinary thing look deliberate.

nodes.name: Gouf B4
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Perimeter complete. Twenty-four clips and no moving furniture.{pause}He performs a full tug test while the neighbor checks every bulb.{pause}One dark lamp is replaced without lowering the rest of the string.{pause}Gouf admits repair access is an attractive kind of power.{pause}The committee writes DEPENDABLE in larger letters on his badge.{pause}They step back with twenty minutes left for the final pattern.

nodes.name: Gouf 11
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The main tune returns as the first guests enter the courtyard.{pause}Children chase their own shadows while adults unfold the last chairs.{pause}The anchor system holds, but the unused lights remain in a bright heap.{pause}Twenty bulbs still need a shape before the dance begins.{pause}Gouf could make a plain grid, yet the committee wants one special detail.{pause}Everybody looks toward the cable, then politely looks toward Gouf.

nodes.name: Gouf 12
nodes.speaker: Child
nodes.dialogue: Can the lights look like a whirlpool in the sky?{pause}Another child requests a glowing dinosaur with accurate proportions.{pause}The committee suggests a border that helps guests find every table.{pause}The fern owner requests one respectful spotlight for the plant.{pause}Gouf writes every idea in chalk until the ground becomes impossible.{pause}He circles SKY SPIRAL and SAFE PERIMETER as the two buildable plans.

nodes.name: Gouf 13
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: A spiral would pull every eye upward and turn the dance floor grand.{pause}A perimeter would make exits, tables, and pathways easy to see.{pause}Both can use the anchors already installed, with different tension.{pause}The cable can lift the final loops, but people must clear the center.{pause}Clips can finish the border, but the result may seem ordinary.{pause}The choice is no longer about skill. It is about what guests need.{pause}Before deciding, Gouf walks both proposed paths at guest height instead of judging them from the{pause}reach of his cable.{pause}The spiral looks spectacular from the center but leaves the food tables dim and turns the{pause}exit sign into a distant green speck.{pause}The perimeter makes every walkway legible, though the empty middle feels less like a dance floor{pause}and more like unfinished sky.{pause}Children suggest paper stars between the two plans, proving ordinary clips can create height{pause}without another dangerous throw.

nodes.name: Gouf 14
nodes.speaker: Neighbor
nodes.dialogue: My mother would choose crooked lights and more places to sit.{pause}She would also cheer for the spiral, then move her chair beneath it.{pause}Gouf says safety and wonder should not have to become enemies.{pause}They walk every route together and mark three clear exits.{pause}The chairs finally settle in rows that leave the dance floor open.{pause}Even the fern is parked beyond cable range with a fine view.

nodes.name: Gouf 15
nodes.speaker: SYSTEM
nodes.dialogue: Power test begins. Forty bulbs light in one warm wave.{pause}The old outlet hums but stays within its sensible little limit.{pause}A gust crosses the courtyard and every anchor answers differently.{pause}The tree line sways. Wall clips hold. The fern's leaves applaud.{pause}Gouf adjusts tension until movement looks gentle instead of alarming.{pause}He has learned the system well enough to choose either finish.

nodes.name: Gouf 16
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: I wanted one perfect throw so everyone would know I helped.{pause}The title melody returns while neighbors clip napkins and move chairs.{pause}Now every knot carries somebody's hand, permission, or good warning.{pause}The neighbor says that is what decoration is supposed to remember.{pause}Gouf looks at his cable beside the box of ordinary clips.{pause}His specialty may be connecting things without keeping them attached.{pause}He coils the practice cable slowly and notices every repaired place where another person shortened,{pause}redirected, or softened his first idea.{pause}Those changes do not diminish the throw; they turn a private display into a structure the{pause}courtyard can safely inhabit.{pause}Gouf asks the children to mark their favorite sightline with chalk while the neighbor checks the{pause}exits again.{pause}The final design will begin from what people can see and reach, not from where his weapon can land.

nodes.name: Gouf 17
nodes.speaker: Committee
nodes.dialogue: Dance begins in five minutes. Final lighting plan, please.{pause}The sky spiral promises spectacle and one carefully cleared center.{pause}The perimeter promises calm paths and one very proud certificate.{pause}Guests wait with cups, instruments, and increasingly dark shoes.{pause}Gouf takes the final strand and checks both routes once more.{pause}He chooses the shape this courtyard will remember after tonight.

nodes.name: Gouf C1
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Overhead spiral selected. The courtyard needs one safe spectacle.{pause}He clears the dance floor and assigns neighbors to every loose end.{pause}The cable lifts the remaining lights in a slow widening circle.{pause}Clips catch each loop before the next loop leaves the ground.{pause}Children count turns while the committee guards marked exits.{pause}A glowing whirlpool forms overhead without swallowing one cracker.

nodes.name: Gouf C2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Music starts, dancers turn, and the spiral seems to turn with them.{pause}One cable tail brushes a chair leg and begins a tiny polite orbit.{pause}The chair collects a second chair, then the fern's rolling stand.{pause}Gouf stops the motion before it reaches the snack table.{pause}Everyone holds position while he lowers one loop and adds two clips.{pause}The furniture keeps a graceful semicircle as its permanent contribution.

nodes.name: Gouf C3
nodes.speaker: Neighbor
nodes.dialogue: It is spectacular, and the chairs discovered choreography.{pause}Gouf bows to the chair orbit, then inspects every anchor again.{pause}The fern glows at the edge beneath its own respectful little loop.{pause}Guests dance under a spiral that moves only with the wind now.{pause}The sky tune rises while children point out constellations in bulbs.{pause}One constellation looks exactly like a ladder nobody had to carry.

nodes.name: Gouf C4
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Final report: forty lights, three exits, one furniture ballet.{pause}The committee keeps the spiral for every clear-weather party.{pause}Gouf builds a small wheel stop for the fern's rolling stand.{pause}The child who requested a whirlpool names the pattern Courtyard Galaxy.{pause}Next year, Gouf arrives with clips, permission forms, and chalk.{pause}He also brings a ladder, just to prove the specialty was a choice.

nodes.name: Gouf D1
nodes.speaker: Gouf
nodes.dialogue: Perimeter lighting selected. Straight lines and gentle corners.{pause}He clips the remaining bulbs along exits, tables, and garden paths.{pause}The cable reaches high hooks while neighbors secure each lower span.{pause}Every chair stays free, every snack remains unilluminated.{pause}The fern receives a tiny arch that marks the quiet seating corner.{pause}Guests can see every place they might want to go.

nodes.name: Gouf D2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The party spreads instead of gathering under one bright center.{pause}Older neighbors find chairs easily, and children trace the lit garden path.{pause}Musicians carry cables to the stage without tripping once.{pause}The snack table glows warmly while keeping every cracker ordinary.{pause}Gouf waits for disappointment, but the courtyard keeps filling.{pause}Dependable light has made room for everyone else's spectacle.

nodes.name: Gouf D3
nodes.speaker: Committee
nodes.dialogue: For straight lines, clear exits, and one happy fern, we thank Gouf.{pause}They present a DEPENDABLE LIGHTING certificate in a blue paper frame.{pause}Gouf accepts it with more pride than he expected to feel.{pause}The quiet ending tune plays while he checks one final corner clip.{pause}The certificate goes beside his volunteer badge on the food wall.{pause}Guests add signatures until the border is cheerfully crooked.

nodes.name: Gouf D4
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Gouf frames the certificate at home before removing his boots.{pause}At later parties, neighbors request his gentle corners by name.{pause}He still brings the cable, but he also brings twice as many clips.{pause}The fern keeps its private arch and becomes the courtyard landmark.{pause}Nobody remembers that dependable lighting once sounded like an insult.{pause}They remember seeing every face clearly when the music began.
